title: Vital Freebase E-Liquid – Smooth Tobacco 60ml
description:
Introducing Smooth Tobacco by Vital 60, an e-liquid that offers a classic and smooth tobacco flavour that is perfect for those who love the taste of tobacco. This e-juice is perfect for vapers who want a smooth and satisfying vape experience that is reminiscent of traditional tobacco cigarettes.
With every puff, you’ll experience the rich and smooth taste of tobacco, which is enhanced by the high-quality ingredients used to create this e-liquid. The flavour is subtle yet satisfying, and it is perfect for those who want a classic and timeless tobacco flavour.
Smooth Tobacco by Vital 60 is also available in different nicotine strengths, so you can choose the level of nicotine that best suits your needs. This e-liquid is perfect for those who are looking for a satisfying and smooth vape experience that is reminiscent of traditional tobacco cigarettes.
Flavour Notes:
Smooth Tobacco
70 VG 30 PG
